meta.note: Every factor carries a source and an uncertainty band. The engine propagates the band to every result. Point estimates are never shown without their range.
meta.verification_status: HACKATHON BUILD - factors are literature values and must be re-verified against the primary source editions cited before commercial use.

IN_GRID_NATIONAL.label: India national grid (weighted average)
IN_GRID_NATIONAL.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
IN_GRID_NATIONAL.note: Declining year on year as RE share grows. Re-check latest CEA database version.

IN_GRID_STATE.label: State grid variants (regional mix adjustment)
IN_GRID_STATE.source: Derived from CEA regional grid mixes
IN_GRID_STATE.note: Coal-heavy eastern states run materially higher than RE-rich southern states. This single choice can move a Scope 2 result by 40 percent.

IN_SOLAR_CAPTIVE.label: Captive rooftop solar (operational)
IN_SOLAR_CAPTIVE.source: Operational emissions nil; high bound reflects embodied lifecycle if amortised
IN_SOLAR_CAPTIVE.note: Reported as zero at the operational boundary, consistent with GHG Protocol Scope 2.

DIESEL.label: High speed diesel (genset / captive)
DIESEL.source: DEFRA GHG Conversion Factors - stationary combustion

FURNACE_OIL.label: Furnace oil / LDO
FURNACE_OIL.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol.2 residual fuel oil NCV and EF

COAL_INDIAN.label: Indian non-coking coal (high ash, grade dependent)
COAL_INDIAN.source: IPCC 2006 Vol.2 other bituminous, adjusted for Indian ash content and NCV
COAL_INDIAN.note: Widest uncertainty band of any fuel here. Indian coal grade G1-G17 swings NCV substantially.

BIOMASS_BRIQUETTE.label: Agri-residue briquette
BIOMASS_BRIQUETTE.source: Biogenic CO2 excluded per GHG Protocol; value covers CH4 and N2O from combustion only
BIOMASS_BRIQUETTE.note: CRITICAL METHOD POINT: biogenic CO2 is reported separately and not counted in the Scope 1 total. Only non-CO2 combustion products are counted. A tool that silently zeroes biomass is not auditable.

ALU_SECONDARY.label: Recycled aluminium
ALU_SECONDARY.note: Roughly 95 percent lower than primary. Largest single circular lever in the library.

RAIL_FREIGHT.label: Rail freight
RAIL_FREIGHT.note: Roughly 4x better than road per tonne-km. Modal shift is a large low-capex Scope 3 lever for bulk inbound.

LANDFILL_ORGANIC.label: Organic waste to landfill
LANDFILL_ORGANIC.source: IPCC Waste Model, CH4 from anaerobic decay, AR6 GWP100

ANAEROBIC_DIGEST.label: Anaerobic digestion (organic)
ANAEROBIC_DIGEST.source: Net of avoided landfill CH4 and displaced fossil gas
ANAEROBIC_DIGEST.note: Negative: diverting organics from landfill avoids methane that would otherwise have been emitted.

RECYCLING_GENERIC.label: Segregated recycling
RECYCLING_GENERIC.source: Processing burden only; material credit is booked on the input side
